title: Coffee Iced Latte with Non-Dairy Milk, Flavored

content.title: About
content.content: Iced latte is a cold coffee drink made with espresso, ice, and plant‑based milk (soy, almond, oat, etc.). The flavored version adds a syrup such as vanilla, caramel, or hazelnut for extra taste. It is popular in warm weather and suitable for those avoiding dairy.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Iced latte originated in Japan in the 1980s as a response to the growing demand for cold coffee beverages.
Plant‑based milks lower the saturated‑fat content compared with cow’s milk.
Flavor syrups are often derived from natural extracts but can also contain artificial components.
Cold coffee retains most of the antioxidants found in hot espresso.
Common flavor options include vanilla, caramel, honey, coconut, and hazelnut.

items.title: Caffeine boost
items.content: Espresso provides caffeine, which can increase alertness and improve concentration.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee is rich in polyphenols that help combat free radicals in the body.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Using plant‑based milk makes the drink suitable for people with lactose intolerance.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Coffee contains niacin, riboflavin, and vitamin B6, supporting metabolism.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The large proportion of water and ice contributes to overall fluid intake.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat after caffeine.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Flavored syrups are often sweetened, increasing the drink’s calorie count.

items.title: Allergy to plant milk
items.content: Soy, almond, or other plant milks can trigger allergic reactions in susceptible people.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee’s natural acidity may irritate the stomach of those with gastritis.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the iced latte in tall glasses over ice, adding the chosen flavored syrup. Top with plant‑based whipped cream and a sprinkle of cinnamon or cocoa powder if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Prepared drink should be kept refrigerated and consumed within 24 hours. Store unopened plant‑based milk in its original container, tightly sealed, at 1‑4 °C.
